messages:
Maya (Finance): Hey team, batch invoice job for 2026-03-22 produced duplicates and dropped some reserved-capacity credits for customer BrightWave. Seeing 2 invoices with same invoice_id and one missing a -$3,750 credit line.
Sam (Billing): Ugh, I see the dup too. invoice_id 2026-03-BW-0042 appears twice with different totals. One is $18,250, one is $14,500.
Jorge (Billing-ops): Quick sanity check: did the nightly retry run concurrently? We had a transient S3 timeout at 03:12. BillingBot posted a retry at 03:13.
BillingBot: job=billing.batch_invoicer status=partial_fail rows_processed=1,024 errors=1 retry_triggered=true
Maya (Finance): Attached is the CSV diff I generated: BrightWave lines show missing reserved_capacity_credit row in the second invoice. I can attach to the support ticket if we decide to issue a credit note.
Sam (Billing): Can we diff the raw usage blob for the account? If the usage extractor duplicated the group key we might have merged two partitions incorrectly.
Liam (Engineering): I'll pull logs now. Initial guess: hash collision in partition key function after a config tweak last week. Running a local repro.
Liam (Engineering): Repro shows two records collapsed into one file when key normalization dropped region tag: e.g. "project:brightwave:region:" became "project:brightwave:" and hashed the same.
Jorge (Billing-ops): That explains the missing line — reserved credits were on the collapsed record that got dropped. Who changed normalization?
Liam (Engineering): I can open PR to revert normalization and add explicit region marker. Also will add a post-processing check to forbid duplicate invoice_ids in a single batch.
Sam (Billing): Thanks. For now can we regenerate the invoice for BrightWave and mark the duplicate as void? We need to issue a corrective credit before EOD.
Maya (Finance): Please create a ticket for customer-facing action. I need the corrected invoice PDF + credit memo. I will loop in Account Exec to approve the credit.
Liam (Engineering): Created ticket BLG-5821 with repro, logs, and fix PR link. Will run a corrected batch in staging and share sanitized CSVs.
BillingBot: ticket=BLG-5821 linked job=billing.batch_invoicer run=1792349200 status=queued
Jorge (Billing-ops): Once staging run looks good, Sam can mark invoice 2026-03-BW-0042 (duplicate) as void and replace with regenerated 2026-03-BW-0042-R1.
Sam (Billing): Will do. Also request finance approval for a one-time automatic credit of $3,750. Maya can confirm.
Maya (Finance): Approved pending signed credit memo. Sam, send draft to legal and AE.
Sam (Billing): Draft sent to Legal and AE. ETA for corrected invoice + credit memo: 3 hours after staging green.
Liam (Engineering): Staging run completed, no duplicates, reserved_credit lines present. Uploading sanitized artifacts now.
BillingBot: artifacts: /artifacts/BLG-5821/brightwave_sanitized.csv uploaded
Jorge (Billing-ops): Great. Sam, proceed to void dup and push corrected invoice. Make sure to annotate affected subscription IDs on the memo.
Sam (Billing): Voided duplicate, pushed 2026-03-BW-0042-R1, credit memo queued. Sending confirmation to Maya and AE now.
Maya (Finance): Thanks team. Let's add a monitoring alert for batch invoice collisions and add this scenario to the runbook. :thumbsup:
Liam (Engineering): I'll add an alert for duplicate invoice_id count > 0 and a step in the runbook.
Maya (Finance): Closing loop: Customer notified, credit memo pending AE signature, fix PR merged to main. Will reopen if anything else pops up.
_meta: generated_for_dataset: finance invoice generation failures; note: single-thread Slack format, short messages, includes bot and logs
